items.name: permission-editor
items.title: Permission Editor
items.description: A compact permission workspace with category navigation, search, enabled filtering and controlled scope rows.
items.docs: Map your permissions to sections of groups of rows; each row has an id, a label, an optional hint, whether it is enabled, and optionally the levels it can reach and the current one. onEnabledChange and onLevelChange report changes by row id. Every word comes through props, English by default.
